runtime_overrides: Current host binaries and units in RAM on the earlier immutable laboratory host.
Public UID entries, QEMU binaries and gateway image copied into RAM with manifest verification.
Production gateway filesystem; only host fixture stderr goes to the volatile lab journal.
Online fixture uses a serial acknowledgement barrier before gateway activation; capture is outside the outer host VM.

persistence.guard_metadata: Includes guard selection and confirmation timestamps, order and path-bias counters; this is persistent operational metadata.
persistence.excluded: Chat data, destination history, logs, bandwidth history, consensus/descriptors cache and circuit-build statistics.
persistence.usb_write: Only a changed Guard record set or missing profile; atomic staging/fsync/rename/directory fsync. LastWritten changes alone do not cause a write.
persistence.readonly: Import into RAM without writing; encrypted general image is byte-identical before and after the tested lifecycle.
persistence.stop: Revoke API, graceful Tor stop, final selective snapshot, host save acknowledgement, VM destruction, then storage closure.
persistence.crash: Last successful checkpoint remains; changes since it may be lost. The nominal 35 seconds is not a hard deadline under scheduling or I/O faults.
